answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 5 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the crystal release is recorded with every signature, the delta audit publishes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the karst graph and each risks its bond. That is 31 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
